name: Aakash Reddy
bio: Hi! I'm Aakash, and I'm a senior from Atlanta, GA studying Public Health. My favorite teams and interests include the Atlanta Falcons (28–3 memes <<< literally anything else), Atlanta Braves, and F1. My professional interests include sports medicine, dermatology, and thermoregulation. In my free time, I enjoy playing soccer, fishing, and cooking people in fantasy football.

name: Alex Toohey
bio: Hi! I'm Alex, a sophomore from San Francisco majoring in Data Science. I love all Bay Area sports teams, especially the Giants, 49ers and Warriors, and am also a fan of Bayern Munich and Michigan Football + all the Cal teams of course. In my free time I enjoy playing tennis, IM flag football, fantasy football, hiking, skiing, watching good TV shows, and trying new food.

name: Gaby Campos
bio: Hii! I'm Gaby, a sophomore studying Data Science. I'm from LA, so naturally I support the Lakers, Kings, LA Galaxy, Dodgers, and the Raiders. Favorite sports to watch in person are hockey, volleyball, and soccer. Outside of sports, I love listening to music, reading, and gaming. Anyways, feel free to reach out even if it's not school or sport related!!

name: Jacob Siegel
bio: Hi! I'm Jacob, a senior majoring in Data Science and minoring in history. I'm a big fan of the Giants, Tottenham, and all Cal and Bay Area sports teams. I love using data to find new ways to look at sports, specifically baseball, which I have done across the country and as a student manager for Cal Baseball. Feel free to reach out, I'd love to chat!

name: Jade Abrica
bio: Hi, I’m Jade! I’m a junior from Los Angeles and a Media Studies major. My favorite sport is primarily baseball, but I enjoy gymnastics and soccer as well. My hobbies include baking, island reggae, and intense movie/show watching.

name: Kian Naini
bio: Hi everyone, my name is Kian and I’m from Santa Monica, California. I’m a junior majoring in Molecular and Cell Biology. Some of my favorite teams are the Dodgers, Lakers, New York Giants, and of course all of our teams here at Cal.

name: Lucia Kim
role: VP of Merchandise | Interim VP of Finance
bio: Hi, my name is Lucia, and I’m a junior studying Integrative Biology. I love watching baseball and my two favorite teams are the San Diego Padres and the Kiwoom Heroes. In my free time, I enjoy binge-watching movies, going to the beach, and finding new dog parks!

name: Matthew Takagi
role: Head of Data Journalism | VP of Technology
bio: Hi! I'm Matt, a sophomore studying DS, CS, and City Planning from Fullerton, CA. I'm a hockey, baseball, and soccer fan, supporting the Anaheim Ducks, Angels, and Liverpool, in addition to the Japan National Team. A lot of my work centers around rules, mechanics, and their impact on game theory, so if that interests you, feel free to reach out!

name: Nihal Mareedu
bio: Hey! I’m Nihal, a junior from the bay doubling in Econ & DS. I’m a professional bowler and love supporting the 49ers, Warriors, Giants, Valkyries, and the Indian national cricket team. My professional interests are consulting, product management, Private Equity, and Investment Banking. In my free time, you can catch me hitting a lift, running pickup, or doomscrolling.

name: Orlando Pereira
bio: Hello there! I'm Orlando and I'm a senior majoring in Applied Mathematics. I have an unnatural dedication to baseball and an eternal love for the New York Yankees. I do, however, dabble in most other major sports. Beyond that, I love cooking, learning languages, number puzzles, and enjoying life. Feel free to reach out!

name: Praneel Chellapilla
bio: Hi! My name is Praneel, and I am a sophomore from Folsom, CA. I am studying Data Science and Political Economy. My favorite sports teams are the Sacramento Kings and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Specific to sports, I love talking NBA Draft prospects, and outside of sports, I have a wide variety of interests, so feel free to talk to me about anything!

name: Preston Bhat
bio: Hi! I'm Preston, a sophomore from the Bay studying Mechanical Engineering. I'm a Niners, Warriors, and Giants fan. You can find me watching RedZone at my place on Sundays.

name: Rohan Baxi
bio: Hey everyone! I'm Rohan and I'm a junior from Davis, CA studying Economics. I play soccer and love to watch basketball and football. My favorite teams are the Sacramento Kings and Cleveland Browns. You can find me hooping at RSF, in the student section of Cal football and basketball games, sweating over who to start in my fantasy football lineup, or exploring a new part of the Bay Area.

name: Sanjana Alluri
bio: Hey! I’m Sanjana and I’m a Senior from the East Bay studying Data Science and Cognitive Science. I’m the biggest Dubs fan and have a lot of love for football and wrestling (not WWE!). Talk to me about music, movies (MCU!), food, sports, classes, or anything else!

name: Shreyes Sridhara
bio: Hey y’all! I’m Shreyes and I’m a senior majoring in EECS. I’m a tennis fanatic and love analyzing anything that could possibly tell me why one player had a hidden edge over their opponent. Besides tennis, I like chilling with friends, skateboarding, trying new restaurants, and playing other sports! Did I mention that I like tennis?

name: Siddharth Srinivasan
bio: Hi guys, my name is Sid! Originally, I was born and raised in MA before moving to Hawaii in 2020, where I built an appreciation for the role sports play in shaping community. Whether it's playing tennis, watching the Patriots claim Super Bowls, the Celtics win championships or witnessing young Hawaiian superstars progress to the big leagues, my passion for sports has been shaped by the places I've called home.

name: Twesha Ghosh
bio: Heyyy! My name is Twesha Ghosh and I am a rising senior majoring in IEOR and EECS. My favorite sports are tennis, basketball, and soccer. Becoming the World #1 tennis player is one of my side hustles in my dreams :) Apart from sports, I love going out with my friends, climbing, yapping, and doing anything that involves takings risks and having fun!

name: William Lee
bio: I'm William and I'm a Junior studying Physics and Data Science. Sports-wise I'm a huge baseball fan and root for the Toronto Blue Jays and also follow basketball, F1, and sometimes football and soccer. Outside of sports I love cooking/eating new foods, traveling the world, and watching movies.

name: Yash Dighe
role: VP of Technology | Interim VP of Finance
bio: Hey! I'm Yash and I'm a Junior from the East Bay currently majoring in Data Science and Applied Math. I'm a big 49ers and Warriors fan, but I'll tune in for international events for other major sports. Talk to me about your terrible sports hot takes, rock music recommendations, or academics.
